g.text: Eight-frame rolling-origin forecasts: small steps retain transport timing; direct jumps collapse toward a smooth trace
Each point is the terminal value of a separate 25.055-µs forecast; this is not one uninterrupted free trajectory. Bands show the three-seed range.
